responsibility: Implements tree/GIMPLE exception-handling bookkeeping and cleanup. It maintains the mapping from potentially-throwing statements to EH landing pads or MUST_NOT_THROW regions, builds and redirects EH edges and dispatches, analyzes whether operations and statements can trap or throw, duplicates or cleans EH annotations during CFG/body transformations, and performs the cleanup pass that prunes unreachable or empty EH regions and updates function EH personality requirements.
same_name_distinction: Defines the tree-level EH machinery itself: statement-to-landing-pad tables, EH edge creation/redirection, cleanup pass implementation, and verification logic. Unlike gcc/tree-eh.h, this is the implementation file that realizes those APIs and the ehcleanup pass.
